title.en: An Act to Amend Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred and Eighty-Six
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred and Eighty-Six

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_377_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 2 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section two of Republic Act Numbered Two hundred and eighty-six is amended to read as follows:
"

The boundaries and limits of the territory said municipality are established and defined as follows:
"Starting from a point in the intersection of latitude S°" 04' 00" North, and longitude 123° 10' 00" East going in a straight line eastward to the provincial boundary line between Zamboanga and Misamis Occidental, thence north¬ward along that same provincial boundary up to the line defined by latitude 8° 20' 00" North, thence westward along that same latitude 8° 20' 00" North until it intersects the longitude 123° 10' 00" East, thence southward in a straight line down to the starting point."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 14, 1949.
